narr: An area of low pressure moved along a slow moving cold front bringing numerous showers and thunderstorms to Maryland. Multiple rounds of heavy rain occurred throughout the afternoon and evening. Total rainfall amounts of one to four inches were observed where flooding occurred.
ev: Trained spotters and MDOT report several lanes on the outerloop of I-695/I-97 south of Baltimore are impassable due to water on roadway.
Baltimore City Emergency Manager reports water has flooded cars along Aliceanna Street in Fells Point. Several cars stuck.
Several roads were blocked (either by 6 to 8 inches of flowing water or a few feet of standing water), particularly in the North Point area and along Key Highway.
